description: Kadro dependency updates: weekly, grouped, never merged automatically. Security alerts open pull requests outside the schedule.

packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for every minor and patch update of the npm dependencies, except the Expo SDK family below.
Expo SDK packages move together with the SDK release (the overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml and expo-doctor hold the alignment), so they get their own group and major updates are reviewed by hand.
Major updates open one pull request each so they can be reviewed on their own.
Workflow actions are pinned to full commit SHAs and updated in one weekly group.
node-forge (ADR-0043) and braces (ADR-0078) carry the two advisories ignored in pnpm-workspace.yaml; no patched release exists, so no update is proposed until the ADRs are reviewed.
